reason: Owner decision 2026-11-03: trim metformin to one target. ChEMBL lists two mechanisms: mitochondrial complex I (CHEMBL2363065, ~50 subunits, no single representative protein) and mitochondrial GPD2 (CHEMBL3391681, single human protein). GPD2 is used as the one target so complex I subunits do not swamp target counts. Metformin's mechanism is contested.
